config.notes: Baseline probability models only. Splits match the primary five. Isotropic noise uses the same stream id and seeds as the primary experiment, so those rows should match the baseline arm.

notes.correlated_noise: population covariance of the training fold, plus a 1e-8 relative ridge before Cholesky
notes.dropout: each feature dropped independently and replaced by the training-fold mean
notes.multiplicative_noise: X * (1 + level * Z); negative values are kept
notes.worst_group: isotropic noise on the 10 features whose names start with 'worst '
